content.text: Based on my investigation, I have found the root cause. Let me update the ticket with the resolution:

input.note:
**Root Cause:** The ingress-nginx controller was upgraded to v1.12.1 over the weekend with `allow-snippet-annotations=false` enabled as a security hardening measure. This disabled support for the `nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/configuration-snippet` annotation that your legacy-portal Ingress relies on for the regex-based redirect rules.

**Evidence:** The controller logs show: "W0517 02:03:12.882455 skipping annotation nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/configuration-snippet on ingress legacy/legacy-portal: Snippet directives are disabled by the Ingress administrator (allow-snippet-annotations=false)". Requests to `/old/...` return 404 because the redirect rule is not being processed.

**Fix:** To restore the redirects, use the standard ingress-nginx rewrite annotations instead of configuration-snippet. Replace your configuration-snippet annotation with:
```
nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/rewrite-target: /portal/$1
nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/use-regex: "true"
```

And update your Ingress path pattern to capture the regex group (e.g., `^/old/(.*)$`). This approach doesn't require snippet directives and will work with the security-hardened controller. See the ingress-nginx documentation for `rewrite-target` and `use-regex` annotations for the exact syntax needed for your URL mapping.

Alternatively, if the standard annotations cannot express your redirect logic, contact the platform team about enabling `allow-snippet-annotations=true` on the controller, though this carries security implications.
